latest_release.name: v1.4
latest_release.body:
- Firefox 161 support
- Adjusted browser rounded corners for Breeze user theme
- Improved background blur rendering thanks to Firefox 161
  - As a result, the preference `parfait.theme.blur.enabled` is no longer experimental
- Missing sidebar warning now shows up for users without the sidebar button
- Fixed wrong arrow icons in overflowing context menus
- Fixed sidebar background blur disappearing during animation
- Fixed tab dragging slightly off in floating sidebar
- Other fixes
